description: This file defines a CancelablePromise class that implements a promise with cancellation support, along with related classes and interfaces for handling cancellation errors and callbacks.

classes.name: CancelError
classes.description: Custom error class for cancellation, extending the built-in Error class.

classes.name: CancelablePromise
classes.description: A Promise implementation that supports cancellation, with methods to resolve, reject, and cancel the promise.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the promise, triggers cancel handlers, and rejects with a CancelError.
